notes.title: Major Update (Space Voyager Mode)
notes.notes:
[h3][h1]Meet the new mode: Space Voyager![/h1][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f1b4ace2252147b8c2e5ea30ceb10f154353131a.jpg[/img]


[list]
[*]Added a mode in which players can experience a journey through space while traveling to the next planet.
[*]Defeat enemies and avoid asteroids while moving through space to get the highest score on the leaderboard. 
[*] To travel between planets (for example Mercury => Venus, Venus => Earth, Earth=> Mars) you must pass the Space Voyager stage.
[/list]


[h2][Space voyager rules][/h2]

[olist]
[*] Destroy the approaching bullet blocks to score points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/3a755efb02ecb7c526b12516efca890592d9ffc4.gif[/img]

[*] Colliding with an asteroid delays arrival time and reduces HP

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/3903fec7d2ab100b3e4c49d780a6bfd96bf0ed04.gif[/img]

[*] You can dodge in all directions and get a higher score by destroying more blocks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/26920d18025467fbd5abae05a283790bc0a28366.gif[/img]
[/olist]

[h1]Debuffs - say goodbye to your rackets... [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f25b37c28fbb7cd3ae6750df1d831c626646e293.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/9f61591ad57a9f8b9c12536afd160a4b9e75370a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/d64bf29bf5d768909bc3b7edbadafff63fbcecb8.png[/img]




[h1]Useful items - time to have some fun! [/h1]

Lightsaber - slash everything with style

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/eb715a424b49f5115d898c568f13248cd197f29c.png[/img]

Plasma gun - shoot the bullet blocks before they reach you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/5afff528d666a4c2f773c19435f1478a335f41f5.png[/img]





See you in space, traveler!

notes.title: Major Update (Centipede Stage)
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage Update
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b][Centipede Stage]
[/b][/h3]

: For much more exciting play, Centipede stage that pressures the play with its own movements is added. 
Experience your nostalgic game in VR space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/667c2e020fe129cb5ae2841558922c61afd8387a.png[/img]



[h3][b][Game Play][/b]
[/h3]

1) 'Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage' maintains the same form as existing blocks, and can be destroyed using a ball. Since Centipede’s movement is very irregular, you need to focus as much as possible to target its head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a82584c10d16b8cc73beb8b4f24d319ef07728ef.gif[/img]



2) When Centipede’s head is destroyed, the body breaks down along. But when the body is destroyed while the head is undamaged, it separates into 2 or more and gives stronger pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif[/img]

The stage consists of 4~5 waves in total. As the stage progresses, Centipede with higher HP appears or the body is designed to destroy easily.


3) Centipede turns into a Bullet Block when it reaches a certain area, and begins to attack. The number of close blocks must be reduced as much as possible. As the more close blocks you have, the more simultaneous attacks you will receive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fe758683294f561780937658744a300c43628204.gif[/img]



[h3][b][Score Initialization, Lobby UI Improvement][/b]
[/h3]

: 4 chapters of Space Block Buster has 10 stages each, and Centipede replaces 2 stages of each chapter. This will initialize some of the existing stage's scores, and players can earn points by playing the Centipede stage.

Stages that include Centipede has different icon background from existing stages, which makes it easier to distinguish.
(1-4, 1-8, 2-4, 2-8, 3-4, 3-8, 4-4, 4-8 Stage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6017a7be3d013f617d85038d7b09d941985732f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update (Multiverse Mode)
notes.notes:
Multiverse Mode has been added through the update.
Multiverse Mode is a PVP mode that allows you to compete against other players and compare your game skills with opponents.

[h2][Round Configuration]
[/h2]Multiverse Mode consists of a total of 3 rounds. The time of each round, the number of blocks and the HP of the blocks will gradually increase, and the player can use the item to remove the block faster than the opponent or eliminate the opponent using the attack item to win the game.

During each round, a warm-up time of less than 5 seconds is given, and information on items that will appear in that round is announced. It is recommended for players to check this before taking on the stage, or plan to eliminate opponents. Of course, it is also possible to use the warm-up time to provoke or mock the opponent next to you. There are no restrictions on enjoying space sports, except for foul play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/486dbf97818f975fe1c45cfa328eb3bd68f03bf2.gif[/img]

[h2][Description of Additional Items]
[/h2]Attack items that can only be used in Multiverse Mode have been added.

[b]1. Boxing Glove changes the opponent's racket into a boxing glove.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f25b37c28fbb7cd3ae6750df1d831c626646e293.png[/img]

[b]2. Acoustic Guitar changes the opponent's racket into an acoustic guitar.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/9f61591ad57a9f8b9c12536afd160a4b9e75370a.png[/img]

[b]3. Broom Stick changes the opponent's racket into a broom.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/d64bf29bf5d768909bc3b7edbadafff63fbcecb8.png[/img]

[b]4. Speed Up increases the opponent's ball speed.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/1c94f78e1303e24b0c54be1fbafde851df3a7033.png[/img]

[b]5. Little Pong makes the opponent's ball small.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/5925fd99488dd16d4ef7895377740010667fd3a8.png[/img]

You must use the new items added to interfere with your opponent's game. Interference will be applied to the opponent in the direction of the racket used to acquire the item. Players who are affected by the item effect should not panic and prepare by checking the countdown that appears before the effect begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a49bc9974629560c84e4b334161f67b5d10fd04c.gif[/img]

[h2][Tip]
[/h2]You can play normally even if your opponent accidentally loses their life and is out of the round first. Using this time to get the most points is critical to winning. Conversely, a 'perfect round' happens if someone first removes all the blocks spawned on the stage. If someone achieves a perfect round, the round ends immediately and the next round begins. In other words, the key to victory is to achieve a perfect round or to interfere and get the opponent out.

notes.title: The First Update (New Chapter, Items, Boss, Mode)
notes.notes:
[b]Happy New Year everyone!
We bring you the extremely welcome news of Space Block Buster's first update.
A new stage and mode, as well as many new items, have been added!![/b]

[h2][b]1. Stages[/b][/h2]
[b]1) Chapters 3 Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]The block pattern of each stage in Chapter 3 was changed
[*]New items and a new block added[/list]
: When the block approaches a player and reaches a certain distance, the block will not be able to suppress its anger and will fire towards the player. This is called a Bullet Block.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/46588ea8d22f58ec4b8b45dffef1f90013c19f97.gif[/img]
  
[b]2) New chapter added (Chapter 4)[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new chapter set called Mars
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/ab0bdb22d515e4a43f13a16dc7718e0862fcf69c.png[/img]


[b]3) New boss added (Chapter 4 boss: Moai)[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill: Some of the blocks that are currently created change to Bullet Blocks and fire.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/1b5f81f8484812792a2bba06272ddeae6ac7e50a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c9d8fc1312f726cf38892d9e1b5a8817bde62439.gif[/img]


[b]4) New mode added to Endless mode[/b] 
[list]
[*] Added Endless mode with no items
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/86dac88b858781c8ec195f7d193bd5cc148f0d9a.png[/img]


[h2][b]2. Items[/b][/h2]
[b]1) 2 new items added[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Lightsaber[/b]
[/list]
: It can deal with Bullet Blocks flying towards the player by slicing them.
 (But it also splits balls and changes them into 2 Little Pongs. Appears after Chapter 4)

[/list]
